note: The owner's countdowns for BHTracker's Hub, beside the ones the collector adds by itself (only dates an official post states for certain). Only the owner edits this file (the /hub-dates skill); the collector never writes here, and the owner's word always wins: an entry here replaces an automatic one of the same name that year, and removed takes an automatic one out (its name and year). kind: season, battle-pass, event, esports or other. start and end: a date (2026-10-07) or a time with its offset (2026-10-07T17:00:00Z); at least one of them. resets: what resets on a clock - name (what players read before "in 5 h 12 m"), every (day or a weekday), at (05:00) and zone (UTC or the region the game keeps, America/New_York).
